answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybils. Each agent locks a 60 POA bond in a vault, and it loses 2 POA per epoch, so one identity costs 2 POA per epoch. A garden of honest traders renews one bond each and keeps its full yield, while an attacker with 1,000 fakes burns 2,000 POA per epoch — 120,000 over 60 epochs — far more than those ghosts earn. Renewal is public, like water draining from a lagoon, so shrinking bonds flag fakes before they vote.
